title: Twenty Twenty-Four Theme Review
description: A documentation-led profile of the Twenty Twenty-Four block theme, its patterns, style variations, and full-site-editing workflow.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped, documentation-led Twenty Twenty-Four WordPress theme profile from KreativWP.
highlights: WordPress documents Twenty Twenty-Four as a block theme designed for full site editing
Its bundled patterns support business, writer, and portfolio-oriented page structures
The theme includes alternative templates and multiple style variations through the Site Editor
bestFor: Teams that want to stay close to WordPress core and are ready to create their design system with the Site Editor and patterns.
researchScope: This profile checks the WordPress.org listing and official theme documentation. It records documented Site Editor capabilities and patterns, not production performance or migration outcomes.
caveats: No controlled content migration, accessibility audit, or third-party plugin study has been completed. Confirm that a block-first workflow works for the people who will maintain the site.
